critique: The black background, centered turquoise-green radial motion, and strong circular silhouette now read much closer to a Ring Explosion. At 1.9s the ring is clearly contained in frame and has a clean hollow center. However, it remains an overly dense, thick particle donut rather than a sharper explosive perimeter: the band is packed with so many small particles that it reads as a continuous fuzzy torus. The 0.08s frame is still only a smooth glowing dot, with no readable particulate ignition.

suggestions.why: Reduce the burst population substantially so the mature ring resolves into individual explosive particles instead of a solid, fuzzy annulus.
Smaller particles will preserve the circular particle structure while reducing the heavy, soft thickness of the ring band.
